scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:3333/health && electron ."
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dist: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron/electron-builder.yml
